evidence: Matches the RPC/REST/ZMQ label and modifies JSON-RPC batch execution handling in src/httprpc.cpp.
rationale: Fixes a JSON-RPC 2.0 compliance bug where parsing errors on non-object batch elements inherit the previous element's ID or silently drop errors following a notification. While it ensures RPC response correctness per spec as noted by pinheadmz ('could confuse consumers of the interface expecting unique IDs in batch responses'), the trigger involves malformed non-object batch items, making it an edge-case bug.
